$comment: DogChaseBones tuning. Edit freely - nothing here changes game rules, only fit, feel and colour.

camera.$comment: Margins from the 393x852 stage edge to the camera fit rect. The grid is scaled to fill what is left, with square cells. Dog queues render inside these margins and may run off-screen.

editor.$comment: The editor is its own view, not the phone frame - it fits the grid to whatever room the scene panel has. padCells is the margin kept around the grid so dog queues stay on screen.
editor.$groupTints: Block-group colours in the editor only - the game paints every group with colors.block. Eight hues, kept at least 30 degrees apart: a longer list only makes neighbours look alike, which is worse than reusing one. When the list runs out it comes round again at a different lightness AND with a hatch pattern on the tiles, so a thirtieth shape is still its own.

colors.$tierBadge: Bone tier badge: a filled square, deliberately unlike the round dark count pip beside it.

debug.$comment: showBeeReach paints every cell a bee can currently reach. Handy while authoring bee levels.
